**KOReader Workbench**: the Preview area becomes a workbench for setting up KOReader on your computer — Bookends, Bookshelf, fonts, margins, patches and the sleep screen, with a live picture from the real KOReader and a way back to the e-reader. This release collects 1.4-beta1 to beta8. Linux and macOS only (the Preview area does not exist on Windows).

## New

- **KOReader in the background.** The Preview area starts the desktop KOReader invisibly at the full resolution of your device and shows its screen as a picture. Starting takes about a second, every further page a tenth of a second. Two views: the *reading page* (sample text, a book of your library with its book data, or any file) and the *start screen* (file browser or Bookshelf, with sample books or your library, the selected book counting as the one read last).
- **Use it like the e-reader.** Click into the picture to turn pages (left third back), or to tap on the start screen (Bookshelf's buttons, menus, books); right-click is a long press, Ctrl+click taps on the reading page. Drag to swipe; the mouse wheel turns pages or scrolls.
- **Pages below Preview** in the sidebar, each with its settings on the left and the picture on the right. Changes are drafts that only show in the picture until *Save to profile*; *Discard* goes back. Sections fold away and Bookbench remembers which are open.
- **Bookends:** presets (choose, create, duplicate, delete, activate), Bookends on/off, the lines of all six positions with the token list of your installed Bookends, style, size, capitals, offset and odd/even pages per line, bars inside a line (`%bar`), up to eight progress bars across the page, extra margin per position, font size, scale, margins and truncation, and *Special characters …* with KOReader's symbols. Changes show in a fraction of a second.
- **Bookshelf:** layout, font sizes, covers and spines, themes (also per shelf), wallpaper, plank, decoration and ornaments, colours for day and night, the top panel (current book with editable lines of the hero card, or modules), modules, start menu and shelves — plus a list of every key in its settings file.
- **Font and margins:** KOReader's general reading settings (font, size, weight, spacing, kerning, hinting, contrast, embedded fonts and style, margins). The page shows which values the book shown brings along in its book data, and can ignore them in the workbench.
- **Sleep screen:** KOReader's sleep screen options — wallpaper (cover, chosen image, random image from a folder, reading progress, book status, leave the screen), border fill, stretch, crop, rotate, ignoring the cover, the message with placeholders, box or banner, height and opacity, and what happens after waking. The workbench shows the sleep screen while the page is open. Images from elsewhere are copied into the profile and go to the e-reader with the rest.
- **Patches:** your user patches as in KOReader's patch management — on/off, all off, show, add, delete; patches that fail in the workbench are marked with KOReader's message. Bookbench brings its own patch **2-bookbench-subtitle** (also attached to this release): it reads the subtitle and calibre's custom columns from each EPUB, so Bookshelf gets `%subtitle` and `%calibre{name}` works in Bookshelf and Bookends without `metadata.calibre`. Copy it into `koreader/patches/` and restart KOReader.
- **To the e-reader …** (toolbar): shows what you changed in the preview profile since it was taken from the e-reader — Bookends, Bookshelf, wallpapers and ornaments, sleep screen images, patches, style tweaks and KOReader's settings key by key — and writes what you tick to the connected e-reader after a backup. Items also changed on the e-reader meanwhile are marked as conflicts; device-specific settings are never offered.
- **Open in KOReader** opens the full KOReader in a window as before (reading page or start screen), on its own copy with the drafts, for trying out menus.

## Changed

- The workbench works on a throw-away copy of the preview profile, recreated at every start; reading positions, history and settings of the profile stay untouched. Only Bookends and Bookshelf are loaded there, other plugins could cover the screen.
- *From the e-reader* and *From backup* warn before replacing a profile Bookbench has changed; quitting asks about unsaved workbench changes.
- *Choose …* buttons in the settings dialog are no longer cut off. English interface: menu shortcuts no longer clash (*E-reader* is Alt+R), the *Parts* column on the E-reader page scrolls.

## Notes

- Box/banner, height, opacity and the chapter placeholders of the sleep screen exist since KOReader 2025.10.
- KOReader stops in the background when Bookbench closes, and by itself 30 seconds after a crash.

## Install

- **Linux:** *Help > Check for updates* in an installed copy, or `install.sh` from this repository.
- **Windows:** `Bookbench_Setup_1.4.exe` (not signed yet: SmartScreen > *More info* > *Run anyway*). The Preview area does not exist on Windows.
